neighbours.label: the word just before 'probability'/'chance' in statements about random events ('infected with ⟦a certain⟧ probability', 'carriers have a 25% chance')
fire: In the model, each customer leaves the queue with probability q at every step.
A mutation spreads to a neighbouring cell with a small probability each generation.
Two heterozygous parents have a 25% chance of a child with the recessive trait.
Each bit of the message is flipped with probability one half by the noisy channel.
In this game, a player wins the round with probability equal to the card's value.
Failures occur randomly and with a fixed probability during each hour of operation.
The algorithm accepts a worse solution with a probability that decreases over time.
Every node forwards the packet with probability p to one of its neighbours.
quiet: In the model, each customer leaves the queue after exactly q steps.
A mutation spreads to a neighbouring cell with a small delay each generation.
Two heterozygous parents have a child with brown eyes and dark hair.
Each bit of the message is flipped with a mask by the encoder.
In this game, a player wins the round with a score equal to the card's value.
Failures occur at night and with a loud noise during each hour of operation.
The algorithm accepts a worse solution with a penalty that decreases over time.
Every node forwards the packet with a header to one of its neighbours.

notes: Card: peaks on ' with' x7, ' have', ' occur', ' independently' right before probability/chance phrases; the output promotes 'probability', 'chance', 'likelihood', 'odds'. Probe: 'retained with probability p' 0.55 vs 'painted with a different colour' 0.25. Near misses keep the math/stats register but no probability.
